title: Personal Loans State Fee Schedules: Late and Returned-Payment Fee Figures
content:
Larkspur charges Personal Loans late fees and returned-payment fees under three state fee schedules, A, B and C. The figures are the same in every grade, Personal Loan Grade A through Personal Loan Grade G.

## Fee figures

| Item | Fee schedule A | Fee schedule B | Fee schedule C |
|---|---|---|---|
| Late fee, percent of the unpaid portion of the installment | 5.0 | 5.0 | none (flat fee) |
| Late fee minimum, USD | 15.00 | no minimum | none |
| Late fee maximum, USD | 30.00 | 15.00 | none |
| Flat late fee, USD | none | none | 10.00 |
| Returned-payment fee per returned payment, USD | 15.00 | 10.00 | 0.00 |

| Item | Every grade |
|---|---|
| Grace period before a late fee may be assessed | 15 calendar days after the due date |
| Most late fees for one installment | 1 |
| Most returned-payment fees on one loan in a calendar month | 2 |

## Definitions

- **Grace period**: calendar days after a due date before a late fee may be assessed on an installment still unpaid.
- **Schedule A**: late fee percent of the unpaid portion of the installment; minimum late fee, USD; maximum late fee, USD; returned-payment fee per returned payment, USD.
- **Schedule B**: late fee percent of the unpaid portion of the installment; maximum late fee, USD (no minimum); returned-payment fee per returned payment, USD.
- **Schedule C**: flat late fee, USD; returned-payment fee per returned payment, USD.
- **Most late fees per installment**: most late fees that may be assessed for one installment (integer).
- **Most returned-payment fees per calendar month**: most returned-payment fees that may be assessed on one loan in a calendar month (integer).

## Reading the percent, minimum and maximum (hypothetical unpaid portions)

| Unpaid portion | 5.0 percent of it | Fee schedule A figure | Fee schedule B figure |
|---|---|---|---|
| 200.00 | 10.00 | 15.00 (minimum) | 10.00 |
| 360.00 | 18.00 | 18.00 | 15.00 (maximum) |
| 800.00 | 40.00 | 30.00 (maximum) | 15.00 (maximum) |
